name: podcast-viral
description: Talking-head / podcast short: hormozi-pop captions (3 words a line) at 0.70, a big boxed hook title (<= 7 words) for the first 3 s, planned punch-ins on stressed words (about 4-5 visual changes per 10 s, 1.08-1.20, never on graphics, centred on the face), yellow progress bar, -14 LUFS.

based_on.trial: clips-trial-1 (Vinh Giang x Raj Shamani, 5 clips, all QC pass)

notes: Framing is per shot and is NOT set by this template: close-ups use center-crop + `rustler crop track-face <clip>`, wide two-person shots use blur-fit (`rustler clip set-layout <clip> --preset blur-fit --segment-id <seg>`).
Write the hook title yourself (<= 7 words) with `rustler overlay add-text <clip> "..."`, then apply the template again to restyle it; or pass overrides {"hook": {"text": "..."}}.
The trial found the hook text too small at 0.085; this template uses 0.1.
